interruptHandoff.insertMentionForAgent.en: Insert mention for {{agentName}} into your comment
interruptHandoff.insertMentionForAgent.zh-CN: 将 {{agentName}} 的提及插入评论

interruptHandoff.nothingLiveToPause.en: Nothing live to pause - no agent run is in flight or queued. This records a hold so new work won't start until you resume.
interruptHandoff.nothingLiveToPause.zh-CN: 没有正在运行的内容可暂停 - 当前没有运行中或排队中的智能体运行。系统会记录暂停保持，直到你恢复后才会启动新工作。

interruptHandoff.pauseBucket.agent_owned.en: assigned to an agent; no run is live
interruptHandoff.pauseBucket.agent_owned.zh-CN: 已分配给智能体；当前没有运行

interruptHandoff.pauseBucket.human_owned.en: owned by a board user; pausing won't notify them
interruptHandoff.pauseBucket.human_owned.zh-CN: 由看板用户负责；暂停不会通知他们

interruptHandoff.pauseBucket.live_runs.d.en: interrupted now, re-queued when you resume
interruptHandoff.pauseBucket.live_runs.d.zh-CN: 现在中断，恢复后重新排队

interruptHandoff.pauseBucket.queued_wake.en: held - they won't start until you resume
interruptHandoff.pauseBucket.queued_wake.zh-CN: 已保持 - 恢复前不会启动

interruptHandoff.pauseBucket.static.deta.en: no assignee; nothing was going to run
interruptHandoff.pauseBucket.static.deta.zh-CN: 没有分配对象；本来就不会运行

interruptHandoff.plainTextWillNotNotify.en: Plain text won't notify or assign an agent.
interruptHandoff.plainTextWillNotNotify.zh-CN: 普通文本不会通知或分配智能体。

interruptHandoff.previewClearAssignee.en: Clear assignee - no agent will be notified
interruptHandoff.previewClearAssignee.zh-CN: 清除分配对象 - 不会通知智能体

interruptHandoff.previewInterruptHandOff.en: Interrupt current run, hand off to
interruptHandoff.previewInterruptHandOff.zh-CN: 中断当前运行，并移交给

interruptHandoff.previewPlainTextOnly.en: No agent will be notified. Use @ to mention an agent.
interruptHandoff.previewPlainTextOnly.zh-CN: 不会通知智能体。请使用 @ 提及智能体。

interruptHandoff.wakeNotCreatedUnassigne.en: not created - no agent selected. Mention @agent or pick an assignee to dispatch.
interruptHandoff.wakeNotCreatedUnassigne.zh-CN: 未创建 - 未选择智能体。请提及 @智能体 或选择分配对象来派发。

interruptHandoff.wakeNotCreatedUser.en: not created - this is a handoff to a board user
interruptHandoff.wakeNotCreatedUser.zh-CN: 未创建 - 这是移交给看板用户

interruptHandoff.wakeQueuedForAgentWithI.zh-CN: 已为 {{agentName}} 排队（已附加被中断的运行）
